items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: And he was Emmet Hardy's doctor.

ctx.x: Berman French was my brother-in-law. He played with me a while. He played banjo too. Of my first marriage. He was my brother-in-law. Incidentally, from my first marriage, Dr. Lochte was married to my sister-in-law from my first marriage. And he was Emmet Hardy's doctor. See, Emmet developed tuberculosis and Dr. Lochte had done so well with a couple of boys that worked for Canal Bank, I think it was. And he did such a fine job with them. He had those boys out playing baseball again in two years. Henry, Dr. Lochte…
Oh, uh, your father played in these brass bands. Did they ever play any funerals? Well, I wouldn't know that.
